description: This PHP file defines a controller class for an OpenCart extension report related to sale coupons. It handles viewing, saving settings, and generating reports on coupons used in sales.

classes.name: SaleCoupon
classes.description: Controller class for managing the sale coupon report in the OpenCart admin panel, including viewing, configuring, and listing coupons.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main report configuration page with breadcrumbs, header, footer, and view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings via POST request, with permission checks.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the coupon report view with current report data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Provides the list view of coupons, mainly for AJAX or paginated views.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches and compiles the report data, including pagination and filtering, returning the rendered view as a string.
